review_scope: Read-only source and existing CPU artifacts; no fitting or GPU execution by reviewer.

findings.title: Bind the BUILD frame bank contents
findings.evidence: frames_source currently records a path. Geometric trust selection also consumes K, poses, visible/depth_valid/depth_m/scene_depth_m from that bank.
findings.recommendation: Embed the packed BUILD frame-bank SHA, or exact40 original frame SHA values, alongside source hashes. This can be provenance metadata without changing the fixed numerical contract.

interpretation.training_residual: source_self_consistency_abs_depth and solver loss reuse the LiDAR points that define correction. They establish provenance/fit, not independent geometry accuracy.
interpretation.required_outcome: Judge M3 versus M2 with existing evaluate_control.py full fixed visible and measured-depth masks, separately BUILD and HELD. The renderer expected-depth readout differs from a training plane residual.
interpretation.held_depth: HELD9 excludes incremental normal-correction observations, but M2/native/PVD conditioning and shared pose/calibration already use same-scene context. It is an internal incremental-control test.
interpretation.crossfit_limit: Crossfit folds are distinct BUILD frames; inlier/frame preselection uses the full local BUILD set. Their residuals are consistency diagnostics, not an independent test.
interpretation.appearance: fit_geometry_arm.py reuses exact saved M2 c0 and inferred flags for M3, starts both from c0, and asserts identical27429 BUILD target RGB pixels. Both have2000 SH0 steps.
interpretation.unknown: Unknown centers retain delta0. Normal/scale/thickness/opacity and original RGB seeds are exactly preserved in the inspected geometry artifacts.

resolved_in_latest_source.title: Current geometry/provenance metadata hashes
resolved_in_latest_source.resolution: Current hashes are computed before metadata serialization and overwrite inherited M2 metadata hashes.

resolved_in_latest_source.title: Standalone input and builder provenance
resolved_in_latest_source.resolution: Input, observations, contract and builder SHA are passed into correct_geometry and embedded before export. Builder errata clarifies projected-nearest depth semantics without altering the preregistered numeric method.

examined_artifact_limitation: The inspected local _cpu_measured_geometry.npz predates the metadata-only source fix. Its corrected centers and invariants pass; its embedded metadata must be regenerated with the current builder before delivery.
